# Jersey Elite Coatings

> Premier epoxy flooring and concrete coating company serving all of North Jersey. Licensed & insured, locally owned, installing since 2010. Services include garage epoxy flooring, polyaspartic 1-day coatings, metallic & decorative epoxy, full-broadcast flake systems, commercial epoxy, industrial floor coatings, basement epoxy, and restaurant kitchen flooring. Every floor is backed by a lifetime warranty against peeling and delamination.

## Key facts
- Service area: All of North Jersey — Essex, Hudson, Bergen, Passaic & Morris counties. Town coverage includes Newark, Jersey City, Hoboken, Clifton, Paterson, Montclair, Wayne, West Orange, Livingston, Ridgewood, Paramus and Morristown.
- Method: Diamond grinding surface preparation on every floor — never acid etching. 100% solids epoxy and aliphatic polyaspartic systems. Calcium chloride or RH moisture testing before basement and slab-on-grade installs.
- Credentials: Licensed & insured in New Jersey. Certificate of insurance on request. Free on-site quotes with physical color & flake samples. Lifetime warranty against peeling and delamination.
- Pricing: Residential epoxy typically $3–8 per sq ft installed; a 2-car garage (≈400 sq ft) runs $1,200–$3,200. Metallic systems $7–12 per sq ft. Commercial $4–10 per sq ft; urethane mortar $8–15 per sq ft.
- Timeline: Standard epoxy garage 2–3 days (walk in 24 hrs, park in 72). Polyaspartic 1-day system: walkable the same evening, drivable in ≈24 hours.
- Winter: Polyaspartic keeps curing down to ≈0°F, so unheated North Jersey garages can be coated November–March; standard epoxy needs a slab above ≈55°F.
- Phone: (973) 378-1192 · Email: info@jerseyelitecoatings.com
